# AI Agent Study Guide

> Documentation repository studying 8 AI coding agent implementations for building your own agents.

Sources:
- Aider: https://github.com/paul-gauthier/aider
- Codex: https://github.com/openai/codex
- Claude Code: Anthropic (Closed)
- OpenCode: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode
- Kata: https://github.com/gannonh/kata
- Get-Shit-Done: https://github.com/glittercowboy/get-shit-done
- Oh-My-OpenCode: https://github.com/sizzldev/oh-my-opencode
- Kimi K2: https://kimi.com

## Entry Points

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): AI agent instructions and coordination (read first)
- [docs/tools/README.md](docs/tools/README.md): Tools landing page with comparison matrix

- [docs/tools/UNIFIED-HARNESS.md](docs/tools/UNIFIED-HARNESS.md): Multi-provider harness architecture
- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): Complete context dump for deep understanding

## Key Best Practices (Summary)

### 1. Thin Orchestrator Pattern (Critical)

Keep orchestrators thin (30-40% context), spawn subagents with fresh 200k context.
Sources: Kata, Get-Shit-Done, Oh-My-OpenCode, Aider (Architect mode)

### 2. Category-Based Delegation

Route by semantic category (visual-engineering, ultrabrain, quick), not model names.
Source: Oh-My-OpenCode

### 3. Wave-Based Execution

Execute independent tasks in parallel waves.
Sources: Kata, Get-Shit-Done, Kimi K2

### 4. Sequential Approval Processing

Process approvals one at a time, never in parallel.
Sources: Codex, Claude Code

### 5. Wisdom Accumulation

Learn from successes, persist patterns across sessions.
Source: Oh-My-OpenCode

### 6. PARL (Parallel-Agent RL)

Trainable orchestrator + frozen subagents, optimize for Critical Steps.
Source: Kimi K2

## Unified Harness Architecture

The harness provides:
- Multi-provider support (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Local)
- Multi-agent orchestration (hierarchical, mesh, swarm)
- Generic event loop pattern
- Extensible tool registry
- Session persistence and forking

See: [docs/tools/UNIFIED-HARNESS.md](docs/tools/UNIFIED-HARNESS.md)

## Message Types (Universal)

### Input (User → Agent)
- user_message: Submit user message
- tool_approval: Approve/deny tool execution
- interrupt: Abort current task
- config_update: Update settings

### Output (Agent → User)
- turn_started/complete: Turn lifecycle
- text_delta/complete: Streaming text
- tool_call/result: Tool execution
- approval_request: Needs user approval
- error: Error occurred

## Key Facts

1. This repository documents **8 AI coding agent implementations** (Aider, Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Kata, Get-Shit-Done, Oh-My-OpenCode, Kimi K2)
2. Best practices synthesized from all tools in BEST-PRACTICES.md
3. Multi-provider harness architecture in UNIFIED-HARNESS.md
4. Each tool has consistent README with diagrams
5. Documentation-only repository (no implementation code)

## Interactive Diagrams

The repository includes interactive Mermaid diagrams with clickable nodes:

| Feature | Location | Description |
|---------|----------|-------------|
| Interactive HTML | `docs/tools/interactive-tools-overview.html` | Full interactive experience with tabs, expandable cards |
| Clickable Markdown | Tool READMEs | Mermaid `click` handlers linking to sections |

**Mermaid Click Syntax:**
```mermaid
click nodeId "url" "tooltip"
click nodeId "#anchor" "Jump to section"
```

**Note:** Click events require `securityLevel: 'loose'` in Mermaid initialization.

## Verification Commands

| Command | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| ./scripts/render-diagrams.sh | Validate Mermaid diagrams |
| glow docs/tools/BEST-PRACTICES.md | Preview best practices |
| ls docs/tools/*/README.md | List all tool READMEs |
